recentEvents: 2026-11-04 9M update: organic +6%, adjusted operating profit +10% cc, all 2026 guidance confirmed; shares +4.6% on the day (Borse Global/KBC). KBC noted AI investment appears shifted into Q4, so no guidance raise.
2026 buyback up to EUR 500m: EUR 264m done (3.9m shares at avg EUR 67.97) at 2026-11-04; new mandate up to EUR 75m for 2027-01-04 to 2027-02-22. 2025 buyback was EUR 1.1bn at avg EUR 128.45.
Net debt EUR 4,070m (2.0x EBITDA); small German consumer tax sale (EUR 40m) and Financial Reporting & Regulation (FRR) divestment.

H1 2026 (2026-08-05): revenue EUR 3,033m, adjusted operating margin 29.4%, adjusted EPS EUR 2.83 (+14% cc), AI product roll-outs (UpToDate Expert AI, CCH Axcess agentic modules, Libra, expanded OpenAI partnership).
valueTrapFlags: WHY IT DE-RATED: AI-disruption fears for professional information. Sep 2025: sector sell-off (Clinical Solutions/OpenEvidence concerns, CEO transition) removed ~3 P/E turns (Bernstein). 2026-02-03: shares fell almost 9% after Anthropic launched a legal tool aimed at in-house lawyers (City AM). 52-week price change -21.8% at 2026-10-23; fell to a 52w low of EUR 53.70, now ~67% above it. Not driven by reported results, which stayed solid (organic +6%).
Reported revenue growth only +2% (cc +4%) vs organic +6%: divestments and a ~2pp FX drag; print drag ~100bp; Legal & Regulatory and Health organic growth only +5%.

FY2026 adjusted margin guided to ~28.0% against 29.4% in H1: heavy Q4 AI/product-development and restructuring spend; Morningstar sees slower growth in key AI-related segments and AI monetisation as an open question.
Buybacks (FY2025 EUR 1.1bn, 2026 EUR 500m) plus dividends exceed adjusted FCF; net debt/EBITDA rose from 1.6x (FY2024) to 2.0x. Adjusted FCF growth only +3% cc in 9M 2026.
